input.subject: Question about invoice
input.body: Hi, we were charged twice this month for our Enterprise plan. Can you clarify the billing cycle and refund the duplicate charge?

classification.urgency_reasoning: Standard billing inquiry regarding a potential duplicate charge, not causing an immediate system outage.

response.draft_first_response: Hello, thank you for reaching out regarding your invoice. Invoices are generated on the 1st of each month or on the annual renewal date, and you can view and download all invoices at Settings → Billing → Invoices. Please note that invoice disputes must be raised within 30 days of the issue date. Let us know the details of the duplicate charge and we will investigate and process a refund if verified.
